vb_textbox.text: The Red and the Purple gnomes use a red basket. The Green and the Brown gnomes use a yellow basket. Higher number of mushrooms appears if you keep use the same basket.Keep choosing the Red gnome and the Purple gnome, until the bonus drops to lower than 3.Then, keep choosing the Green gnome and the Brown gnome until the bonus drops to lower than 3.Keep switching between the two combinations.
